messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for The Hop Tap?
messages.body:
Hi Tracey,

Thanks for being straight with me, and for talking it through with your husband.

Just to clear that up, Jake isn't an old crowd only act. His show is the classics from the 50s, 60s and into the 70s: Darin, Dion, Holly, Orbison, Sinatra, Elvis and more. He's the singer, not a tribute, and that mix is what packs the night.

There are dozens of videos on his site so you can hear his voice and watch him perform before anything is locked in.

If it clicks, the four or five provisional dates at £200 cash for the 8pm to 11pm show still stand, and you only confirm the rest after Jake's first night with you. Pick nights from the free Saturdays and Sundays in my earlier email and I'll pencil them the same day. If it doesn't feel right, no worries at all.

Natalie
www.jakeessex.co.uk
